description: Score Core V2. Impact is driven by explicit rule priority and a bounded aggregation policy, never by raw occurrence count. Dimension weights are fixed by the approved product contract and any candidate model that changes them is rejected.

calibration.evidence: Penalties are ordered by product urgency rather than presentation severity: one confirmed P0 caps the overall score below the Great threshold, a P1 group costs roughly a quarter of that, and repeated occurrences of one bounded rule saturate at twice the first-occurrence penalty.
